events.verdict: Thor (WAS) firms up in a screening position in Haliburton's (IND) path and does not deliver contact.
Turner (IND) lowers his arm and avoids making contact with Jones' (WAS) arm during his driving shot attempt.
Nembhard (IND) firms up in a screening position in Thor's (WAS) path and absorbs the ensuing contact.

As Nesmith (IND) moves alongside of Carrington's (WAS) path to the basket, Haliburton (IND) reaches in and makes contact with the ball. His hand slides off of the ball and on to Carrington's arm, but the ensuing contact is marginal.
Nembhard (IND) dislodges Champagnie (WAS) from his rebounding position.
Jones (WAS) steps forward into Haliburton's (IND) space and initiates body contact that affects his SQBR.
Turner (IND) maintains a legal guarding position during Carrington's (WAS) drive to the basket and shot attempt and the ensuing contact is incidental.
Carrington (WAS) commits a take foul on Nembhard (IND).
Turner (IND) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Carrington's (WAS) arm.
